paper_title: Morphosyntactic probing of multilingual BERT models
caption: Random (light color) and random (darker color) performance comparison with different perturbation setups and the unperturbed trained model variants (orange bars). Left-to-right: Blue: Accuracy of the embedding and first layers' probes; Green: Random models with pre-trained embedding layer: no perturbation, , , , ; Red: Random models where the embedding layer is random as well: no perturbation, , , , ; Orange: Unperturbed trained models.
model_annotation: This bar chart illustrates a comparison of accuracy values across several model variations. The horizontal axis displays model names, ordered from left to right, including “1st layer”, “random layers”, “+B1”, “+B2”, “+B3”, “+B4”, “+B5”, “+B6”, “random + perturb”, “random”, “+B2”, “+B2”, and “unperturbed.” The vertical axis represents “Accuracy” and ranges from approximately 65 to 95, utilizing a linear scale. The value axis is labeled with numerical values from 65 to 95, with tick intervals of 5, and units are not specified.  The bars vary in height, with the “1st layer” bar being approximately 82, the “random layers” bars ranging from approximately 75 to 85, the “+B1”, “+B2”, “+B3”, “+B4”, and “+B5” bars ranging from approximately 70 to 78, the “random + perturb” bar approximately 72, the “random” bars approximately 70, and the “unperturbed” bar approximately 88. The bars are all colored in shades of blue, green, and orange, representing the different model configurations. No bars are visually emphasized.
